requirements.title: Local profiles
requirements.acceptance: Create two offline profiles; restart app; each sees only its own history.

requirements.title: Video recording
requirements.acceptance: Record, preview, discard and retry a 10-15 second clip on two phones in airplane mode.

requirements.title: Quality rejection
requirements.acceptance: Run frozen good/bad clips for blur, light, framing, distance and multiple people; explain correct rejection; pilot target >=90% correct acceptance of staged valid clips.

requirements.title: 33-landmark pose extraction
requirements.acceptance: Same frozen clip gives versioned timestamps/confidences and reproducible landmarks on laptop and offline phone within agreed tolerance.

requirements.title: Validated gait features
requirements.acceptance: Version all required features with units/view/missing rules; compare five core features to independent annotations; attach signed tolerance report.

requirements.title: Trained model inference
requirements.acceptance: Load selected classical artifact, validate feature version/order, compare held-out predictions and exported runtime parity; never use synthetic reports as evidence.

requirements.title: Human-readable report
requirements.acceptance: Real offline recording produces measures, sub-scores, quality, limitations and explanations; low quality produces no misleading score.

requirements.title: Non-diagnostic recommendations
requirements.acceptance: Test every reviewed rule against low-score and unavailable-score fixtures; distinguish observation, suggestion and no-diagnosis notice.

requirements.title: Local session history
requirements.acceptance: SQLite sessions persist after restart without internet; no Atlas call is required.

requirements.title: Progress comparison
requirements.acceptance: Offline history compares only compatible protocol/feature versions; insufficient baseline is explained.

requirements.title: Delete any/all data
requirements.acceptance: Delete one session and entire profile offline; verify video, landmarks, features and local history removed with defined backup behavior.

requirements.title: Offline PDF export
requirements.acceptance: Generate readable PDF offline from real report; check overflow, scores, date, quality and disclaimer on two phones.

requirements.title: On-device inference
requirements.acceptance: Complete recording to model/report in airplane mode; compare exported model output to Python fixtures within frozen tolerance.

requirements.title: Capture guidance
requirements.acceptance: First-time users follow framing, angle, countdown and retake guidance; no unsupported angle is scored.

requirements.title: Cloud sync/accounts
requirements.acceptance: Not needed for offline acceptance; keep existing web/cloud tools optional with explicit consent.

requirements.title: Social sharing
requirements.acceptance: No public-sharing dependency in core; public demo contains only synthetic data.

requirements.title: Performance
requirements.acceptance: Benchmark 15 second clips on two physical device tiers; full accepted pipeline <=60 seconds, report median/p95 and failures.

requirements.title: Feature accuracy
requirements.acceptance: Report cadence error against manual reference, proposed <=10% on >=90% accepted clips; freeze reviewer-approved targets before held-out evaluation.

requirements.title: Responsive processing UI
requirements.acceptance: During processing navigation/progress stays responsive; interruption and failure give recoverable state.

requirements.title: Private video by default
requirements.acceptance: Verify no video network traffic in offline core; default deletion after successful extraction; explicit study retention override is logged.

requirements.title: Security
requirements.acceptance: Verify app-private storage, ownership and deletion; optional network transport encrypted; no secrets or real videos in release package.

requirements.title: First-use usability
requirements.acceptance: Observe first-time users completing capture/result in <3 minutes; record failures and assistance rather than assuming success.

requirements.title: Failure reliability
requirements.acceptance: Run low visibility, missing joints, few cycles and corrupted clips; abstain with specific retake reason; review proposed 70% usable threshold.

requirements.title: Modularity
requirements.acceptance: Swap pose/model adapter against fixed contracts without rewriting UI; feature/model versions reject incompatible input.

requirements.title: Single-user scope
requirements.acceptance: Offline operation requires no multi-tenant service; document optional cloud architecture separately.

requirements.title: Android compatibility
requirements.acceptance: Confirm dependency SDK floors and test API 26 target or obtain explicit requirement amendment; test two physical device classes.

requirements.title: Large-text accessibility
requirements.acceptance: At largest supported system font, core controls and reports remain usable with clear labels and no clipped critical text.

requirements.title: Zero-internet operation
requirements.acceptance: Fresh installed release with bundled models completes capture to history/export/deletion in airplane mode without login/download.

requirements.title: Approved collection and consent
requirements.acceptance: A-01 through A-05 verified by human; each included record has actual signed current consent and code-only manifest.

requirements.title: Paired dataset and provenance
requirements.acceptance: Collect approved target cohort/trials; audit hashes, failures, independent annotations and true distance; reject visual estimates.

requirements.title: Leakage-free evaluation split
requirements.acceptance: Freeze split manifest; no participant/hash crosses train/validation/test; preprocessing and score reference fitted on training only.

requirements.title: Privacy lifecycle and withdrawal
requirements.acceptance: Approve exact retention dates; exercise coded withdrawal across videos/features/annotations/backups and verify access log.

requirements.title: Baseline comparison and evaluation
requirements.acceptance: Reproduce constant/linear and RF results with grouped tuning, untouched test set, uncertainty and failure report; no false superiority claim.

requirements.title: Explainable consistency sub-scores
requirements.acceptance: Document symmetry, rhythm, posture and sway-proxy sub-scores relative to training reference; uncertainty/abstention and no health-number claim.

requirements.title: Exported model and lineage
requirements.acceptance: Export selected supported model with preprocessing; compare golden predictions across Python/mobile, feature order, hashes and versions.

requirements.title: Core and recommended feature set
requirements.acceptance: Define/test cadence, count, timing symmetry/variability, knee/hip angles, arm swing, trunk sway, shoulder/hip symmetry, normalized stride/speed and contact/swing timing; each needs reference or unavailable status, not invented outputs.

requirements.title: Advanced measurements
requirements.acceptance: Validate ankle angle, foot clearance, double support and optional head movement against appropriate references before enabling.

requirements.title: Advanced experience
requirements.acceptance: Evaluate front/side fusion, personal baseline, richer local charts, Bangla and PDF; each has separate fixtures/user review.

requirements.title: Anomaly/temporal models
requirements.acceptance: Evaluate Isolation Forest and any temporal smoothing with false positive rate and held-out subjects; no disease output.

requirements.title: Robustness study
requirements.acceptance: Quantify lighting/view/clothing/device variation and failures separately, without hazardous walking tasks.

requirements.title: Reproducible final delivery
requirements.acceptance: Ship APK, offline demo script, dataset/model cards, evaluation report, limitations, user guide and reproducible experiment commands.

requirements.title: Excluded claims and hardware
requirements.acceptance: Audit real and native demo screens: no diagnosis, clinical fall risk, treatment or universal health score; camera-only core, no unnecessary sensors/permissions.
